thread.title: Clevatess Season 2 • Clevatess II: Majuu no Ou to Akago to Shikabane no Yuusha Denshou - Episode 12 discussion

opinions.point: Many viewers considered the episode a major lore-heavy highlight and praised its surprising revelations.
Several commenters enjoyed the unusual reversal of familiar fantasy and isekai conventions.
The community found the protagonist’s unexpected vulnerability and comic reactions entertaining.
Viewers liked the creative practical-effects style, especially the miniature-based destruction and retro tokusatsu feel.
Some commenters admired the episode’s dense world-building, while others felt certain character or story threads received too little attention.
At least one commenter felt the episode was far too short and wanted more runtime.
